transcript: Welcome to the quick start tutorial on the view controls in Marvelous Designer. The main workspace of Marvelous Designer contains the 3D and 2D windows. If you are using the regular mouse preset, you can click and drag the middle mouse button to pan in both the 2D and 3D workspace. Holding ALT and drag with the left mouse button to zoom in and out for a smooth motion zoom. You can also use the mouse's scroll wheel to zoom. In the 3D window, click and drag with the right mouse button to rotate your camera view. Right click with the mouse on any empty space in the 3D window in order to bring up the 3D background options pop-up menu. You can switch to a preset view angle in this menu. You can also use the number keys on your keyboard to access the corresponding views. You can also choose to modify the view controls. By going to the main menu, settings and preferences. In the preferences pop-up window, select view control under presets. You can quickly change your view default to a view control that you are more familiar with. However, to make it easier to follow along with our official tutorials, please choose regular mouse as your mouse preset. You can toggle to other options, but these tutorials will be using the regular mouse preset. frustrations silence Darren Your own result status rights specific situations preferences options status positions settings settings
summary: ```markdown # Quick Start: View Controls in Marvelous Designer Welcome to the quick start tutorial on the view controls in Marvelous Designer. ## Main Workspace Overview The main workspace of Marvelous Designer contains both the 3D and 2D windows. ## Panning in the Workspace If you are using the regular mouse preset, you can click and drag the middle mouse button to pan in both the 2D and 3D workspace. ## Zooming Techniques To zoom in and out smoothly, hold the ALT key and drag with the left mouse button. You can also use the mouse's scroll wheel to zoom. ## Rotating the Camera View In the 3D window, click and drag with the right mouse button to rotate your camera view. ## Accessing 3D Background Options Right-click on any empty space in the 3D window to bring up the 3D background options pop-up menu. Here, you can switch to a preset view angle. ## Using Keyboard Shortcuts You can also use the number keys on your keyboard to access the corresponding views. ## Modifying View Controls To modify the view controls, go to the main menu, then select Settings and Preferences. In the preferences pop-up window, select 'View Control' under presets. You can quickly change your view default to a view control that you are more familiar with. ## Recommended Settings for Tutorials However, to make it easier to follow along with our official tutorials, please choose the regular mouse as your mouse preset. You can toggle to other options, but these tutorials will be using the regular mouse preset. ```
